summary: All In FutureTech Alliance (the Company) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Debt-to-Equity Rights Purchase Agreement to acquire from Rainman Network Ltd. all rights, including creditor and equity transfer rights, under a prior Debt-to-Equity Agreement. This grants the Company rights to receive approximately 43.55% of HyalRoute Communication Group Limited on a fully diluted basis. The purchase price is $1,742,000,000, subject to downward adjustment. The Company will pay consideration to acquire these rights, not direct equity. Rainman must procure joinders from Target Company Parties within 90 days. The deal structure is complex, involving offshore entities and rights acquisition; watch for completion of joinder conditions and regulatory approvals.
